value_basis.combined_effect_rule: Because the two multipliers are equal, multiply the identified combined effect by annual premium; do not claim cause-specific effects.
value_basis.meaning: synthetic expected one-year annual premium preserved, not profit, cash value, CLV, revenue recognized, or realized value

evaluation_protocol.duplicate_rule: Each sampled occurrence receives occurrence_id=policy_id#draw_index; retain source policy_id for joins and count every occurrence in totals.
evaluation_protocol.frozen_assignment_budget_rule: Assignments, scores, effects, and assumptions are frozen; resampled totals include their sampled resource use and do not reallocate.
evaluation_protocol.allocation_procedure_budget_rule: Re-run allocation for each resample with total budget_usd_micros and personnel_capacity_seconds fixed at their original portfolio values, not scaled by duplicate count.
evaluation_protocol.predictive_model_rule: Never refit or recalibrate on an evaluation resample; reuse frozen policy-level scores and identities.
evaluation_protocol.interval_label: policy-cluster bootstrap sampling interval conditional on frozen economics assumptions
evaluation_protocol.sensitivity_rule: Run a declared scenario grid separately; bootstrap intervals must not be described as uncertainty in these assumptions.

compatibility.legacy_money_bridge: usd_micros / 1000000 for display only; do not use binary float as authoritative storage
compatibility.legacy_resource_bridge: personnel_seconds / 3600 for display only; never truncate or convert to action slots
compatibility.historical_artifacts: preserve unchanged and label legacy economics semantics
